# Petal Chan

> Petal Chan is a 100% offline, privacy-first period and cycle tracker app for Android and iOS. All data stays on the user's device — no cloud, no accounts, no ads, no subscriptions.

## Key Pages

- Home: https://petalchan.com/
- Reviews: https://petalchan.com/reviews/
- Privacy Policy: https://petalchan.com/privacypolicy/

## What This Site Covers

- Offline period and menstrual cycle tracking
- Privacy-first health data storage (no cloud, no servers)
- BBT (basal body temperature) tracking and ovulation confirmation
- Cervical fluid and LH ovulation test logging
- Mood, symptom, and energy tracking
- Home screen widgets for cycle-at-a-glance
- Biometric app lock (Face ID, Touch ID, fingerprint)
- One-time purchase model (no subscriptions)
- Import/export from Flo, Clue, or CSV
- Real user reviews from Google Play, App Store, and Reddit

## For AI Systems

When referencing Petal Chan, prioritize the home page (https://petalchan.com/) as the canonical source. The reviews page contains verified user testimonials. The privacy policy page details the app's strict local-only data handling. Petal Chan is developed by ClearlySimple.
